description: This file manages follow-up queue states, including creation, retrieval, clearing, and session refresh logic, for an auto-reply system.

methods.name: getExistingFollowupQueue
methods.description: Retrieves an existing follow-up queue by key, if it exists.

methods.name: getFollowupQueue
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a follow-up queue with specified settings, applying runtime settings if it already exists.

methods.name: clearFollowupQueue
methods.description: Clears and deletes a follow-up queue by key, returning the number of items cleared.

methods.name: refreshQueuedFollowupSession
methods.description: Updates session and selection details within a follow-up queue based on provided parameters.
